column_availability.note: Raw CSV has neither Dropped nor FrameType. Analyzer-reported zero counts mean no rows were marked/filtered by those absent columns, not proof of zero dropped/generated presents. FG off remains externally verified.

clock_correction.reason: Direct intervals measure consecutive present starts. The raw hybrid CSV also contains distinct CPUStartQPC values; using that different clock for interval boundaries was incorrect. Corrected reports pair TimeInQPC with MsBetweenPresents.
